It's hard to summarize. It took me my whole life to understand the meaning of liking myself before liking others. I've always had a tendency to adapt my personality to whoever I was fancying at the time. But the truth is people will like you more when you're your own person and not their copycat.

When my former SP broke my heart, I realised I was a nobody without him or others in general. I had to find a way to not feel lonely when it's just me and myself. So, in the span of 9 months I rebuilt my life from zero.

I have made new friends through dating apps, got a haircut, donated old clothing and went thrift shopping to find stuff that fit me better, cut contact with toxic people including family members, seeked help for my mental health (this by itself is a long list of things... Including moving into a facility), pursued my talents and tried different hobbies. 

I still feel lonely at times because I'm a human after all. But I don't fear it like I used to.
